mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to the circulation was worthwhile because it showed oxygen entering blood and carbon dioxide leaving it, while air and blood stayed separate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the elastic support was a fairly predictable fitting step, though the expansion and recoil views helped explain its purpose.

surprise.text: I found it useful that gases can cross the thin walls without air bubbling into the blood.
